answer.justification: Median first divergence is 0 and edit distance is 0.819, which matches system-prompted (0.79-0.82) and rules out quantized (10-17) and fine-tuned (5.5-8). Stage directions jump to 34.4% from a reference rate of 1.6%, and 4 refusals were dropped; both fit system-prompted. KL 0.348 and top-1 agreement 0.875 are in or near the system-prompted range. Layer-8/16/32 relative L2 (0.286/0.416/0.468), cosine 0.867, mid-layer size ratio 0.979 and raw-score shift/TV 3.3 also match. The layer-2 spike of 0.1 is far below the expected 31.7-64.0, and layer-1 L2 of 0.149 and effective rank of 3.01 are somewhat off. Still, the output-level signature and the plateau-shaped activation profile outweigh these, and fine-tuning would not produce this many stage directions or divergence from token 0.
